newsitem.title: USA: Merck sees Q4, F97 EPS at high end of range.
newsitem.headline: Merck sees Q4, F97 EPS at high end of range.

text.p: Merck & Co Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 1996 and for all of 1997 to be at the top of analysts' estimates.
Analysts estimate Merck's 1996 earnings per share will be $3.13 to $3.19, which implies fourth quarter earnings of $0.80 to $0.86.
Analysts estimate Merck's 1997 earnings per share will be $3.55 to $3.75.

"Based on the strength of our recent performance and the momentum we've been building this year, we expect our fourth-quarter earnings to come in at the top of analysts' estimates," Raymond Gilmartin, Merck chairman and chief executive officer, told a meeting of securities analysts.

"Even at this early stage, we also expect we can deliver 1997 earnings that are at the top of analysts' current estimates. In the years beyond 1997, we believe we clearly have the elements in place to deliver on our long-standing objective of top-quartile earnings growth relative to other leading health-care companies."
